definitions.explanation: A person who buys and sells goods for profit.

⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{商人|しょうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られて→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: The merchants in town would open their shops early in the morning and work until late at night to support their families.

notes:
{商人|しょうにん} is a somewhat formal or literary word for a merchant or trader. In modern usage, it often appears in historical contexts or when referring to traditional business people.

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{商売人|しょうばいにん}→商売人：28054_shoubainin⟧: businessperson, tradesman (everyday tone)
- ⟦{商店|しょうてん}{主|しゅ}→商店主：noentry⟧: shop owner
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦{商|しょう}→貿易商：noentry⟧: trading company/trader

HISTORICAL NOTE:
In the Edo period class system (⟦{士農工商|しのうこうしょう}→士農工商：noentry⟧: samurai, farmers, artisans, merchants), merchants were officially ranked lowest, yet many became extremely wealthy.

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧ has long been known as a city of merchants ({商人|しょうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧), and the expression ⟦{大阪|おおさか}{商人|しょうにん}→大阪商人：noentry⟧ refers to the shrewd, business-savvy character associated with the city.
